Rexy 360 is a '''virtual motion control''' (vMoCo) system: you record your moves as takes and can then shape them.

== Takes and shots ==
* Play the clip and operate. '''REC''' records your move as a take — a '''shot'''. '''PLAY''' plays it back.
* Every shot has its own '''In / Out''' and look. '''I / O''' set the In and Out.
* You can '''Save over''' another take.
* Every shot card in the Library shows a '''move thumbnail''' — the vMoCo curves in their colours — updating live as you record.

== Shaping a move ==
* '''◆ MARK''' drops marks.
* '''✎''' (E) reshapes a track with '''anchors'''.

== Saving moves ==
'''⇩ Save / ⇧ Load''' keep moves as <code>.rxmove</code> files. Moves from Rexy Bridge load too.

Saving a move can '''apply the music to it''', so music-driven movement (see [[Rexy 360: Audio and music#Audio → Move|Audio → Move]]) travels to another clip.
